description:
Hi! I am a Frontend Developer and Data Visualization enthusiast. My core skills include Vanilla JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and Chart.js. I love building high-performance, offline-first web applications that solve real-world problems.

For this hackathon, I am focusing on the 'Flame in Freefall' challenge—building an SI-powered dashboard to interpret NASA's microgravity combustion data. I am passionate about space exploration and how data can be used to make space missions safer.
